name: Eden -Saishuu Sensou Shoujo Densetsu-
source:
Ichinokura Ryuu and twenty-so others stand on an inevitable point in life. Rather, it’d be more appropriate to say they are currently standing on that point quite literally as they gaze at the incoming nuclear missile head about to dissipate them wholly. To think they’ve narrowly escaped from many bad situations today, one of which being the prevention of rape of Kurisu Kanu from the very army who vowed to protect their country, only to face impending doom so soon.

It all started in Minkei Gakuen, on a regular day. Ryuu was asked by his teacher Oogawa to join the student expedition team for Mirokujima, a recently discovered unknown island that never appeared on maps before. The trip which normally would be viewed as “lame” is fueled by the one fact that the “cool, mysterious and beautiful” school, no district idol Kurisu Kanu is participating. At any means it was supposed to be a healthy and safe trip as Ryuu convinces his childhood friend Tsukimura Emu to stay put at home.

The next day Ryuu left for Mirokujima: A supposingly uneventful journey.

[Taken from a [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/06/16/edensaishuusensoushoujodensetsu/]preview post[/url] by Warum]
translation:
一仓龙和其他二十人正站在人生的一个不可避免的转折点上。相反，更恰当的说法是，他们现在正站在这一点上，凝视着来袭的核导弹头，即将将它们彻底消散。想想看，他们今天已经从许多糟糕的情况中侥幸逃脱，其中之一就是阻止红莉栖·卡努被发誓要保护国家的军队强奸，但很快就面临着即将到来的厄运。

这一切都始于民庆学园，一个平常的日子。龙被他的老师大川邀请加入学生探险队前往弥勒岛，这是一个最近发现的、以前从未出现在地图上的未知岛屿。这次通常被视为“蹩脚”的旅行是由一个事实推动的：“酷、神秘、美丽”的学校，没有地区偶像红莉栖卡努参加。无论如何，这应该是一次健康安全的旅行，因为Ryuu说服他儿时的朋友月村鸸鹋呆在家里。

第二天，Ryuu前往弥勒岛：一次据说平安无事的旅程。

[取自Warum的 [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/06/16/edensaishuusensoushoujodensetsu/]预览帖子[/url]]
